<b>Steel Spines</b> are a [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
The Steel Spines can be brought to [[Yarnaby]] in [[Greymoor]] to complete the <i>[[Infestation Operation]]</i> [[Wish]]. After that, they are added to the [[Materium]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Yarnaby.png!Location in Greymoor
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Yarnaby 03.png!Yarnaby in Greymoor
}}

== How to Acquire ==
The Steel Spines are acquired by paying [[Crull and Benjin]] {{R|160}} during the <i>[[Infestation Operation]]</i> [[Wish]].

If the Wish is being completed in [[Act 3]], the Steel Spines can be collected from Crull and Benjin's bodies at no cost.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Crull and Benjin 01.png!Location in Sinner's Road
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Sinner's Road 05.png!Crull and Benjin in Sinner's Road
}}

== Trivia ==
* In older versions of the game, if the Steel Spines were acquired in Act 3, the room could be reentered to respawn them allowing Hornet to acquire more. The Steel Spines have no use outside of the <i>Infestation Operation</i> wish.
